caseNameFull: Doe v. Kirchner and Baby Richard, a Minor, by His Guardian ad Litem, O'Connell v. Kirchner

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Ill. Motions of Yale University Child Study Center et al., Governor of the State of Illinois, arid Paul Simon et al. for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Motion of Catholic Adoptive Parents Association for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae in No. 94-9087 granted. Certiorari denied. Reported below: 164 Ill. 2d 468, 649 N. E. 2d 324.
